title: The Climb
pages:
There is a lighthouse at the bottom of the sea, and its lamp still wants to burn.

The keeper drowned a hundred years ago. He has not noticed. He climbs the stair each night with the oil can, and he stops only where the lamps are lit.

So I climb ahead of him and I light what he cannot reach. While the lamps burn, he is only a man doing his rounds.

I heard him pass my landing twice tonight. He was humming.
